title: `DonateRemote` will fail to deploy when any of the stargate tokens is not set
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  Both `DonateCore` and `DonateLocal` are implemented to allow the donation contracts to work even when any of the `stargateUsdc`, `stargateUsdt`, and `stargateNative` addresses are not set. That means these contracts have the flexibility to support any combination of the Stargate tokens and do not require all to be enabled.  However, `DonateRemote` constructor is implemented to require all the Stargate tokens to be enabled. Without any of them, the constructor will revert and fail to initialize.
